next_action: G1.4: (1) Confirm 'test ! -e artifacts/E100_arc_interface' before the first run (C1: no G1 artifact may predate this point; the pre-registration is 773f1a2 and the verifier is unchanged at SHA-256 7877341122122a821aaf13d3e474ca3d950c2fa756fc6035e4f5bbdba8b5aad1). (2) Run, sequentially and each in its own process: 'uv run python scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/experiments/E100_arc_interface.yaml' twice (seed 12345 from the config), then once with '--seed 12346'. Each run is projected at about 2 minutes (smoke: 1524 fps at 50 actions per game; 125000 steps plus per-step digesting) against the 1800 s limit; run them in the foreground with a generous Bash timeout (600000 ms each) and do not run them in parallel (timing is measured). Each prints {run_dir, completion_status}; require 'completed' for all three and stop to diagnose (L0 retry once, then L1) if not. (3) Run 'uv run python scripts/verify_run.py --gate G1 --report state/verify_G1.json' with the tooling checks ON (it shells out to uv sync, pytest, ruff, mypy; allow 600000 ms). Expect: 12 non-tooling checks plus 5 tooling checks; git_status_clean will FAIL until the artifacts and state are committed, so commit the three run directories (they are evidence; 'git add artifacts/E100_arc_interface') and re-run the verifier if that is the only failure. (4) If replay_final_frame_identity, games_attempted_and_terminal or throughput fail on the real runs, that is a substrate finding under preregistration G1 kill_rule: record it in the ledger with the raw evidence paths, add a dated entry to docs/EVIDENCE_ARC.md (append-only), and do not touch any threshold. (5) On a full PASS: record run digests (SHA256SUMS of each run) and the report digest in the ledger, then the next turn is G1.5 (C5 adversarial self-review: the three strongest artifact arguments, e.g. the environment seed not affecting the games so replay identity is trivially true; the policy seed being the only randomness; digesting cost hiding in throughput), followed by the referee dispatch. Reminders: read 'date -u' immediately before every timestamped write; never name the pre-registration directory in a shell command; use 'git add -A && git reset -q -- state/' only when staging must exclude state; artifacts under artifacts/ are committed including their .log files.
